summary: Minnesota Forest Service lookout site at Ray, Koochiching County: a 1936 100-ft stairway tower the county report marks removed; FFLA lists gone; heights conflict.

facts.status_note: The county report marks the 1936 tower removed and the FFLA Minnesota list marks Ray gone. Neither gives a removal date. The report's notes give 100 ft and 110 ft for towers at the site and do not clearly tie the 110 ft note to either tower.
facts.agency: Minnesota Forest Service (now the Minnesota DNR Forestry Division)

events.note: Second Ray tower, a 100-foot stairway tower erected in 1936 per the county report. Listed as tower 190 on a 1960s list.
Tower 91 appears on a 1939 tower list. The report calls it apparently an earlier tower and says why the list gives that number is unclear.

notes_for_editor: The county PDF lists two towers at Ray with conflicting details. Tower 190 is a 100-ft stairway tower erected 1936 and marked removed. A 1967 note gives 110 ft with a four-legged frame, and the report does not say which tower it covers. Tower 91 has no date and an unexplained 1939 list number. Because of this, height_m and design are left out. The record coordinates (48.43097, -93.24163) match the PDF's (48.4309, -93.2418). The PDF places the site just off Highway 53, northwest of the village. Wikipedia gives the village location at the US 53 and MN 217 junction. The FFLA list says gone with no date. Suggested check: a dated Minnesota survey or DNR historic tower file, or a site visit with landowner permission. Nothing we read describes the site today or public access, so access is omitted.
